heading: EXT. ALPINE GONDOLA CABLE CAR - HIGH ABOVE A GORGE - DUSK

units.text: EXT. ALPINE GONDOLA CABLE CAR - HIGH ABOVE A GORGE - DUSK
A steel cabin hangs from a single cable.
Beneath: a thousand feet of air and a river like a silver thread.
The cable runs taut toward a far station that never seems to arrive.
